issues.issue: Whether police conduct during random stops under Saskatchewan H&TA was an abuse of stop and search powers affecting evidence admissibility.
issues.applicant_position: Police conduct was an abuse, making evidence inadmissible.
issues.respondent_position: Police conduct was lawful; evidence admissible.
issues.result_text: Court found police conduct was lawful; evidence was admissible.

issues.issue: Whether police conduct amounted to an abuse of statutory powers so as to make evidence inadmissible under ss. 8 or 9 of the Charter.
issues.respondent_position: Police acted within powers; evidence admissible.
issues.result_text: Court held no abuse of statutory powers; evidence admissible.

issues.issue: Whether the arrest was valid based on reasonable grounds.
issues.result_text: Court found arrest was supported by reasonable grounds.

issues.issue: Whether the inventory search of the truck was lawful and whether evidence should be admitted.
issues.applicant_position: Inventory search was a breach; evidence inadmissible.
issues.respondent_position: Inventory search was lawful; evidence admissible.
issues.result_text: Court held inventory search was a breach; evidence admitted.
